# Privacy-First Toolbox - Full Tools Directory
> Complete list of free, private, client-side online tools.

## Image Resizer
- URL: https://privacyfirst.tools/tools/image/image-resizer
- Category: image
- Description: Resize images online free. Change photo dimensions by pixels, percentage, or social media presets. No upload required.
- Supported Formats: .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .webp, .gif, .bmp
- Privacy: 100% Client-Side, No File Upload, Works Offline
